author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
The fly brain model is tiny, it can run in my ancient 16G graphic card
Human brain is more complex, but it still can easily run with 2000 GB300, much smaller than the largest LLM
OpenAI and Anthropic should stop building bigger LLM, they should use those GPU to run simulated human brains instead.
We all know humans are safe, unless your simulated brain happens to be Neo.

comments.text: Are you volunteering to be uploaded?
